action.objective: Commit verified f5f6, advancing the passed pawn toward promotion since Black cannot stop it.
action.rationale: f5f6 is the sole commit_ready move. Broad depth-4 search scored it top at exact 2158 (vs 1833 best alternative), and single-candidate verification reproduced 2158 with PV f5f6 Kh6 f7 Kh5 f8=Q, showing the pawn promotes. Safety probe is complete: no immediate Black mate, no checking-reply refutation, and no Black captures available. The pawn on f6 attacks e7/g7, boxing in the king. Previous f5f6 continuation commit failed only due to a format error, not analysis; the same verified move is still valid.
